card.name: The word also before a verb
card.fires_on: The word "also" (sometimes "well" or "assessing") placed right after a subject or phrase and before the main verb, in informal or non-native-style explanatory web prose about countries, laws or health.

modes.label: also before verb
modes.description: "also" inserted after a subject or clause, ahead of the verb it modifies.
modes.example: Dry oral cavity commonly seen in elderly<< also>> cause loss of perception of flavor of food

modes.label: as well / not only but also
modes.description: "also" or "well" completing a paired addition such as "as well as" or "but also".
modes.example: These could as<< well>> be the sacrificial stakes, markets,

modes.label: other verbs or nouns
modes.description: Occasional other words in a similar spot, such as a verb after "responsibility of".
modes.example: The Planning Commission was tasked with the responsibility of<< assessing>> all national resources and increasing deficient resources,

card.plain: It fires on the little word "also" when it adds an extra point before the verb in loosely written explanatory text.
